title: A job placed on CI starts a pipeline through GitLab's pipeline trigger API, and its kb-job runs only for such pipelines
goal: kbjob.py submit of a job placed on ci posts POST <gitlab>/api/v4/projects/<id>/trigger/pipeline with token (read from --trigger-token-file, mode 0600), ref (the pushed commit's branch) and variables[KB_JOB]=JB-...; the job record keeps the pipeline id and web_url and log JOB names it; a failed trigger leaves the job queued with the HTTP status as reason; .gitlab-ci.yml gains kb-job on the docker-linux runner, rules only $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "trigger", running kbjob.py serve --kind ci --job $KB_JOB --once, and every other job stays manual

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
import urllib.parse
class G(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); G.seen.append((s.path,urllib.parse.parse_qs(s.rfile.read(n).decode())))
        b=json.dumps({"id":123,"web_url":"https://gitlab.corp.example.com/corp/kb/-/pipelines/123"}).encode(); s.send_response(201); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
gs=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),G); threading.Thread(target=gs.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
tf=os.path.join(d,"trig"); open(tf,"w").write("trig-placeholder"); os.chmod(tf,0o600)
H.out=dec(executor="ci")
r=kj("submit","check","--name","backlog-check","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA,"--gitlab",f"http://127.0.0.1:{gs.server_port}","--project","42","--trigger-token-file",tf,"--ref","main")
j=json.loads(r.stdout)["job"]; s=json.loads(kj("status",j).stdout)
path,form=G.seen[0]
assert path=="/api/v4/projects/42/trigger/pipeline" and form["token"]==["trig-placeholder"] and form["variables[KB_JOB]"]==[j] and form["ref"]==["main"], G.seen
assert s["pipeline"]["id"]==123 and "pipelines/123" in s["pipeline"]["web_url"] and "trig-placeholder" not in json.dumps(s), s

t=open(".gitlab-ci.yml").read()
assert "kb-job:" in t and '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "trigger"' in t and "serve --kind ci" in t, "no trigger-only kb-job"
blocks=[b for b in t.split("\n\n") if b.lstrip().startswith(("kb-tests","kb-tests-windows"))]
assert blocks and all("when: manual" in b for b in blocks), "a job other than kb-job is no longer manual"

notes: Research 2026-11-08 (kb public/gitlab/variables.md, multi-project-pipelines.md): a trigger token impersonates its creator, who needs the Maintainer or Owner role; variables[KEY] are pipeline variables, held by the project's Minimum role to use pipeline variables (no_one_allowed by default for new projects in new namespaces on GitLab.com since 17.7, then only an Owner can change it). GitLab recommends inputs[name] validated against spec:inputs; whether inputs alone escape the minimum-role setting is not documented (UNK). Before the claim: check the integration project's ci_pipeline_variables_minimum_override_role, and prefer inputs[job] with a spec:inputs header in .gitlab-ci.yml if variables are refused.
